references.title: AI-DLC stage protocol: template overrides
references.summary: Before writing artifact X, the stage resolves a team template at aidlc/spaces/<space>/memory/templates/X.md first; a resolved template is used whole-doc, its ## headings are the skeleton, and the required-sections sensor checks the output against the same file.
references.usedIn: Location and behaviour of the team templates in the workspace package.
references.verificationNotes: The protocol states that no framework default templates ship at GA, so without team templates the stage prose decides the structure.
